title: OpenRepositoryResult
description: Result of repository.open. A rejected path surfaces as a JSON-RPC error carrying a stable code, so this type only ever describes success.

normalizedFromSubdirectory.description: True when the user picked a directory inside the repository and the host resolved upwards to the worktree root. The interface says so rather than silently changing the path underneath them.

repositoryInfo.title: RepositoryInfo
repositoryInfo.description: A validated git working tree the application has accepted. The path is always the worktree root, never a subdirectory the user happened to pick.

path.description: Absolute path to the root of the working tree.

name.description: Leaf directory name of the worktree root, used as the display name.

hasCommits.description: False for a repository with no commits yet, where there is no HEAD to compare the working tree against.

isLinkedWorktree.description: True when this is a linked worktree rather than the repository's main working tree.
